LESSON: INTRODUCTION TO PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Foundations of Pre -Technical Studies
Topic 1.1: Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is Pre- Technical Studies important in day-to- day life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the components of Pre-Technical Studies as a learning area
2. explain the role of Pre- Technical Studies in day- to-day life

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the components of Pre-Technical Studies as a learning area
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the components of Pre-Technical Studies as a learning area. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. explain the role of Pre- Technical Studies in day- to-day life
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the role of Pre- Technical Studies in day- to-day life. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies in the examples.
2. Explain Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
4. Show that you can: identify the components of Pre-Technical Studies as a learning area

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss and present the role of Pre-Technical Studies in day-to-day life,
2. Communication and Collaboration: learner develops writing, speaking, listening, and teamwork skills when discussing, and presenting on the role of Pre-Technical Studies.
3. Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: learner develops open-mindedness and creativity skills when brainstorming on Pre- Technical Studies as a learning area. 2 Values:
4. Unity: learner displays team spirit and collaboration with others when discussing and presenting the role of Pre-Technical Studies in day-to-day life.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the components of Pre-Technical Studies as a learning area
2. explain the role of Pre- Technical Studies in day- to-day life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
